## Security, privacy, and governance

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or real customer/banking data are included.
- [ ] Synthetic data is used in tests and examples.
- [ ] Authentication and authorization boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] RAG grounding, citation, version, and refusal behaviour are preserved or tested.
- [ ] High-risk workflows retain human verification.
- [ ] Documentation and demo-data disclaimers are updated where relevant.
